title: dosecurve: cross-fitted joint model of knockdown and response for single-cell CRISPRi perturbation screens
description: Rust implementation of a cross-fitted joint model that labels perturbed genes as buffered or sensitive from single-cell CRISPRi screens, with reimplementations of two two-step methods, count-level simulations, an identifiability classifier and the analysis scripts of the manuscript 'Calibrated dose-response labels for single-cell CRISPRi perturbations by cross-fitted joint modelling'.

creators.name: Tran, Thai Huu Loc
creators.affiliation: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Hong Hung Hospital, Tay Ninh City, Viet Nam
